tools.name: assessment_checklist
tools.description: Returns a checklist of company details and summary counts used to assess business data for licensing. Requires no company details. Usage metadata is recorded as described in the privacy notice.

tools.name: estimate_data_value
tools.description: Calculates an indicative data licensing range from headcount, founding year, region and number of business systems. Smaller companies receive a clearly labelled rough estimate. Record volumes do not currently affect the calculation. Does not submit an enquiry. Usage metadata is recorded.

tools.name: request_offer
tools.description: Submits contact details and summary company information to Sell My Company Data for human review. Requires the user's explicit request, confirmed contact details and consent to be contacted. Creates an enquiry and triggers internal notifications and a confirmation email.
